value.question: What does a Phase II clinical trial test?
plan: Tests treatment effectiveness in larger patient groups.
Evaluates side effects and optimal dosage.
Determines if the treatment should advance to Phase III.

value.question: What does a Phase II clinical trial test?
plan: Tests treatment effectiveness in larger patient groups.
Evaluates side effects and optimal dosage.
Determines if the treatment should advance to Phase III.
value.draft: A Phase II clinical trial tests how effective a treatment is in a larger group of patients. It also looks at side effects and finds the best dosage level for the treatment. This phase helps researchers decide whether the treatment is promising enough to move on to Phase III, where it will be tested in an even bigger population. These trials are crucial for gathering more data on safety and effectiveness before further testing begins.
